start.name_zh: 6#阀室（大足区，具体乡镇未确认；中敖镇为管线沿线邻近水井所在地）
start.name_en: Valve Chamber No. 6, Dazu District (specific township not confirmed; Zhong'ao Town is the nearest sourced well location along the corridor)
start.geocode_source: Phase 1 EIA confirms 6#阀室 exists on the main Neijiang-Tongliang trunk within the 内江-铜梁段 (mileage context ~136-163km depending on table version, both within Dazu District's general corridor range per GEM's district match), but no location-description table (equivalent to Phase 2's Table 2.2-22) giving 6#阀室's exact township was found in the Phase 1 document. Coordinate uses the nearest sourced groundwater well in the correct district, at 105.699E/29.785N in 中敖镇 (Zhong'ao Town), 大足区 -- explicitly noted in the doc as near the pipeline centerline -- as a district-level proxy, not a confirmed valve-chamber match.

end.name_zh: 大足区（大足供气支线/大足供气管道，龙岗街道，区政府驻地）
end.name_en: Dazu District (Dazu local gas-supply branch), Longgang Subdistrict, the district seat
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '龙岗街道,大足区,重庆市' -> OSM relation 20733873 (subdistrict admin boundary), the district seat/main urban area of Dazu District, ~9.5km from the 中敖镇 start proxy (non-degenerate). Matches GEM's generic EndLocation='Dazu'.

corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the main trunk at 6#阀室 within Dazu District and running to the Dazu district seat (Longgang Subdistrict) to serve local gas demand. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '大足供气管道' among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches (combined 135.6km). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
researcher_notes: Weakest sourcing of the 7 branches: 6#阀室's district (Dazu) is confirmed by cross-referencing multiple table appearances in the Phase 1 doc, but no township-level location description was found for it (unlike 9#, 12#, 16#, and DAT4# which all had explicit 'valve chamber -> township' table rows in the Phase 2 doc's Table 2.2-22 or its DAT-branch equivalent). 中敖镇 is used as the best-available nearest-sourced-township proxy per the task's guidance for un-locatable valve chambers, not a confirmed match to 6#阀室's actual position.
blockers: 6#阀室's specific township within Dazu District is not confirmed; start coordinate is a district-level proxy only.
